communications.subject: StrideFit Running — Order #SF-7723
communications.body: Your CloudRunner Pro Running Shoes (Size 10, Black/Red) are confirmed! Total: $134.95. Free returns within 30 days — just use the return label included in your package.

communications.subject: Your StrideFit Order Has Been Delivered — #SF-7723
communications.body: Your shoes have been delivered! Try them on and if they don't fit, use the included prepaid return label for a free return within 30 days.

communications.subject: Return request — Order #SF-7723 — wrong size
communications.body: The shoes are a bit too narrow. I'd like to return them for a full refund. I'll use the included return label.

communications.subject: RE: Return request — #SF-7723
communications.body: No problem! Please ship the shoes back using the prepaid label. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund of $134.95 within 5-7 business days.

communications.subject: StrideFit — Return Received, Refund Processing — #SF-7723
communications.body: We've received your returned CloudRunner Pro shoes in good condition. Your full refund of $134.95 will be credited to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Thank you!

communications.subject: Where is my refund? Order #SF-7723
communications.body: It's been 2 weeks since you said you received my return and would refund me. I still don't see the $134.95 credit on my statement. When will this be processed?

communications.subject: RE: Where is my refund?
communications.body: We apologize for the delay. We're experiencing a technical issue with our refund processing system. Your refund is in the queue and should appear within 5-7 additional business days.

communications.subject: STILL no refund — Order #SF-7723
communications.body: It has now been 30 days since you said my refund was processing. I have not received the $134.95 credit. Please process this immediately.

communications.subject: No merchant response
communications.body: The merchant did not respond to the cardholder's final follow-up.
